rejected_rule.statement: The law applicable to determine the authority of a mother to accept a gift on behalf of her infant children is Muslim law, as received in Ceylon.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "What then is the law applicable in determining the authority of the mother to accept the gift on behalf of her infant children ? There is no doubt that under Muslim law, as administered 274 in India and laid down in the text books written by Indian authorities on the subject, a mother is not a person who has inherent authority as a guardian of the property of her infant children"
